text:
rachel_sales: Heads-up — BetaCorp POC can't get traces into Redwood Console. They see x-request-id in Splunk but no spans, and their logs in Cloud Logging lack trace linkage. POC demo tomorrow morning, need a quick troubleshooting swarm.

vik_se: @rachel_sales can you share a raw log line + any trace/http headers they send? Also, are they shipping via otel-collector -> Stackdriver OR forwarding logs directly to Splunk?

rachel_sales: They use otel-collector and a fluentd forwarder to Splunk. Sample log they pasted: 
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-10T14:22:01Z","level":"info","msg":"resp sent","request_id":"b3a9","trace":"4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736"}
```
header they included to us: `X-Cloud-Trace-Context: 4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736/0;o=1`

joel_sre: Two likely culprits: 1) The otel-collector's translations aren't populating the Logging API's `entry.trace` field (Cloud Trace uses the full projects/ID/traces/:trace format). 2) Fluentd or Splunk ingestion is dropping the trace context when it reserializes logs.

zeke_eng: Confirmed. For otel-collector using googlecloud exporter you need to map resource attributes -> trace. Example minimal config: 
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols: grpc,http
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  googlecloud:
    project: "beta-prod"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [googlecloud]
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [googlecloud]
```
And in your app logs ensure the traceId is not nested under an unknown key.

vik_se: Also tell them to check sampling in their SDK - set to 100% temporarily for demo. Low sampling makes it seem like traces are missing.

logbot: quota-check: found 5xx/429s from beta-prod to logging.googleapis.com in the last hour, rate limit configured at 40rps.

joel_sre: 429s will result in dropped logs or retries that may lose the trace header. Quick mitigation: increase exporter batch size + retry/backoff. Example collector flags: `max_batch_size: 256`, `scheduled_delay_millis: 5000`.

rachel_sales: BetaCorp says Splunk events show request_id but when they search traces in Redwood Console with that request_id nothing shows. Is there an automatic cross-link?

\eke_eng: We don't automatically join Splunk events to Cloud Trace unless they include the trace id. Best practice: forward both `x-request-id` and `trace` as top-level fields. In Splunk, create a field alias `trace_full` = `projects/beta-prod/traces/` + traceId then you can correlate by trace id.

vik_se: One more gotcha: some fluentd plugins convert numeric trace IDs to integers and strip leading zeroes. That will break the 32-byte hex format. Ask them to ensure trace is treated as string.

rachel_sales: They just confirmed fluentd had `cast` enabled on that field. Asking them to disable cast.

joel_sre: Also validate IAM: the service account used by the otel-collector must have `roles/logging.logWriter` and `roles/cloudtrace.agent` for proper ingestion and linking.

deploy-bot: CI job otel-example-config -> passed. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/blue/organizations/jenkins/otel-example-config/detail/PR-42/1

rachel_sales: BetaCorp flipped fluentd cast off and set sampling to 100% and bumped batch size. New log sample: 
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-10T14:25:13Z","level":"info","msg":"resp sent","x-request-id":"b3a9","trace":"4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736","trace_full":"projects/beta-prod/traces/4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736"}
```

zeke_eng: Nice. If they add `trace_full` to the Logging entry as `entry.trace`, Cloud Trace UI will link logs->spans. For Splunk correlation they can keep `x-request-id`.

vik_se: I'll draft a one-pager for sales playbook: checklist items (service account roles, sampling=100% for POC, do not cast trace id, entry.trace mapping, watch 429s, batch sizes).

joel_sre: I'll add a small runbook for ops to debug: steps to check collector logs, verify OTLP headers, check cloud logging sink filters, and inspect exporter retry metrics.

rachel_sales: Perfect — demo scheduled. Thanks team :party-parrot: marking this thread resolved on my end.

logbot: Note created: "POC BetaCorp - trace mapping & fluentd cast issue" assigned to eng-platform.
